# `map_filter`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

Filters entries in a map using the function.

**Applies to:** Krishiv 0.2.0 and above. Spark: 3.5 and later.

## Syntax

```text
map_filter(expr, func)
```

## Details

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `lambda_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 3.0.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 2 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- map_filter, example 1
> SELECT map_filter(map(1, 0, 2, 2, 3, -1), (k, v) -> k > v);
{1:0,3:-1}
```

## Version history

- Added in Spark 3.0.0.
- Added in Krishiv 0.2.0.
